about.description: XPTa is Assetiko Platinum, a tokenized platinum product on the XRP Ledger issued by Assetiko Commodities Ltd. under the Assetiko group. One XPTa is designed to reference one troy ounce of platinum with reserves that Assetiko describes as one hundred percent physical platinum at claimed coverage of approximately one hundred and one point four five percent. Assetiko discloses issuer identity, custodian, vault operator, insurance carrier, and independent auditor only as "Restricted Records" available upon identity-verified request. No public proof of reserves attestation, no named auditor, and no financial regulator or licence are identified as of this review. The token trades against Valtorum USD (USDV) via an XRP Ledger automated market maker. The XPTa issuer wallet was activated on the XRP Ledger approximately two days before this review with only a handful of trustline holders and a single automated market maker liquidity provider, and the row is flagged Suspicious pending publication of independent reserves verification.
about.registryInfo: Assetiko Commodities Ltd. is named on the Assetiko product page as the issuer of the token. The Assetiko group Legal Notices list only four sister British Virgin Islands Business Companies (Assetiko Holdings Ltd., Assetiko Digital Assets Ltd., Assetiko Treasury Ltd., Assetiko Operations Ltd.), all at the shared registered agent address Craigmuir Chambers, Road Town, Tortola VG 1110, and Assetiko Commodities Ltd. is not explicitly enumerated in that list as of this review. BVI company registration numbers are not published. The Assetiko group explicitly disclaims being a broker, investment adviser, financial adviser, exchange, bank, or custodian, and no financial regulator is identified. Founding team, directors, and officers are not disclosed publicly, and no LinkedIn company page or verified Twitter presence exists as of this review. Custodian identity, vault operator, insurance carrier, auditor, and independent attestation reports are classified as "Restricted Records" available only upon identity-verified request. The row is flagged Suspicious pending publication of a named custodian, a named independent auditor with a reserves attestation, on-chain proof of reserves, and a verifiable regulator or licence. Assetiko's stated reserve methodology for XPTa is one hundred percent physical platinum with a claimed coverage of approximately one hundred and one point four five percent. The current on-chain footprint of the XPTa issuer wallet is de minimis with a small handful of trustline holders and a single automated market maker liquidity provider account, and issuer activation on the XRP Ledger occurred only approximately two days before this review.
